items.note: Pg1 header 'TENTATIVE AGREEMENT'; evidence quote appears verbatim. 'tentative' well-supported.
Pg1 Sec2 refs Appendix C; pg5 'APPENDIX C - EXTRA-DUTY PAY SCHEDULE' full rate tables. Evidence genuine.
'2016-2017 State Budget Act' + 'AB 86 Consortium' appear on pg7 (cited pg3, off). AB86=CA statute. Answer yes valid.
Pg7 item2 'Class Size' matches evidence verbatim; review procedure/goal to explore HS pupil-teacher cap. Correct.
No merit pay (std step/column schedule), but Appendix B Sec3 (pg3-4) ties step/column increases to eval ratings; related eval-linked-pay overlooked.
Evidence verbatim lines 761-762 under CERTIFICATION (printed p.17-18); renewal/endorsement requirements also present. 'yes' supported.
Two-column handbook extracted cleanly (1428 readable lines); 'usable' correct.
Evidence verbatim lines 381-388 under FAIR DISMISSAL ACT, printed p.9; O.C.G.A. 20-2-940 cited. 'yes' correct.
Evidence verbatim lines 934-940; step increases gated by satisfactory/unsatisfactory eval. Real quote; good catch of Stage-1 not_discussed miss.
SALARY SCHEDULE section (l.1037-42) only refers schedule to Comp/Class Unit; no table, no coverage year stated. not_discussed correct, not a false neg.
Fabricated evidence: source (p.4) says 'contract for a fixed term or...career status', NO 'four years' or any period length appears anywhere. Answer '4 years' unsupported.
p.20 describes annual evaluation, PDP, 'you and your evaluator will cooperatively select...assessment strategies and target dates.' Evidence lightly paraphrased but genuinely present.
Confirmed 'Excerpts from Policy 4116.10: Standards of Professional Conduct' (p.33) + Code of Ethics for N.C. Educators (p.35).
Verbatim p.9: 'If you are injured in an episode of violence, you may be paid your full salary during the period of disability for up to one year' (AR 4116.1).
No actual salary schedule/scale grid in doc; only local supplements (by license rating), longevity %s, sub rates, and a LINK to state schedule. 'not_discussed' accurate, not a false negative.

8.2.2/8.2.4/8.2.6/8.5.1 all verified verbatim; procedures right. But answer's '(Aug 15-Sep 30) year-round for non-classroom teachers' garbles a struck restriction that barred classroom-teacher transfers in that window.
IDEA [CFR 300.321] verbatim at 17.6.2.3; 'federal and state requirements' at 17.11.1; 'state and federal law' at 17.6.1. IDEA/34 CFR is a genuine federal citation.
$90/day overage remedy confirmed verbatim in 17.1.6 (elementary) and 17.4.1 (secondary). Answer 'yes' correct.
12.2.1 verbatim: 6.0% eff 7/1/2023, 2.0% eff 7/1/2024; savings note 4%->6% present. Covers all SCTA salary schedules.

True negative. Comp is step-and-column + degree/credential/extra-duty stipends only; 12.11.1 bars differentials except as provided. 'evaluation' keyword (12.8.5.e) is a teacher-in-charge duty, not merit pay.
Art. Fourteen F (p.22-23, lines 1288-1296) matches verbatim: Mar 1 change-of-school; 11+ yrs -> May 4 transfer, Supt grants 10 by seniority.
Answer 'yes' is right (line 1100-1101: duty-free lunch guaranteed), but cited evidence (line 404 lunch-room duty assignment) does not support it; wrong evidence.
'discussed_unclear' defensible, but evidence (A.2, line 748) is about OUTSIDE experience; in-district passage is B.1 (line 792-794, Manchester returning teachers), missed. Note mischaracterizes.
Appendix B (lines 2263-2268) verbatim. 'yes' defensible via Title I/ELL Coordinator, but list mostly role/supervisory stipends (Mentors,BLIC,TAP,Reading,PE), not high-need differentials. Overstated.
Verified not a false negative: 'bonus' = sick-leave/hiring bonus; 'merit'='meritorious' grievance; pure step/lane schedule, no performance/merit/eval-based pay. not_discussed correct.

Quote verbatim (COBRA sec, p47-48). But 'full monthly premium plus 2%' is the COBRA continuation cost for those losing eligibility, not an active-employee premium/contribution; no active premium amount is stated.
Verbatim match p11: defines probationary (1-yr, 3-yr/optional 4th), term, and continuing contracts per SBEC/TEC.
Verbatim match p13 under Reassignments/Transfers/RIF: financial exigency or program change, Board determines, Policy DFF (LEGAL).
pdftotext extracted 2567 clean, well-spaced lines; fully readable. Usable is correct.
Not a false negative. Pay increases explicitly 'based on creditable years of service' (step system); evaluation decoupled from pay; no merit/performance/bonus comp.

Quote real (ln1017) but is grievance-policy DGBA clause ('This policy...'), not a document-scope statement. Doc is titled Employee Handbook (advisory fair); only 'Disclaimer' (pg63) is re computer system. Evidence misapplied.

Verified: 'part-time employees paying into TRS eligible for Katy ISD subsidized medical' (ln1469), 'TRS-Care, the medical insurance plan' (ln1552); 'offers medical coverage to all eligible employees' (ln1789).

Both quotes verified: TRS-Care .65% deduction (ln2514-16) and retiree unused-leave reimbursement 'retire under TRS within 90 days...' (ln2473-74). TRS-Care=retiree medical; post-employ benefits present.
Assault Leave section verbatim (ln1859-62): assaulted employee 'entitled to number of days of leave necessary to recuperate from all physical injuries.' Answer yes correct.

Doc says Board 'shall establish a salary schedule...on an annual basis' (ln1416) but no schedule grid and no stated year coverage. 2014-15 is handbook year not schedule range. not_discussed apt, no FN.
Verbatim at line 243: 'neither a contract nor a substitute for the official District policy manual...' Correctly advisory/not-a-contract.
Std 2.4 quote verbatim (line 1568); answer 'yes' correct. Stronger passage exists: Policy DGA 'Associations and Political Activities' p44.
'Emergency School Closing' section verbatim (lines 2896-97): severe weather/epidemics/emergency; Superintendent decides. Supports yes.
Verbatim lines 357-361: 1yr if 5 of 8 prior yrs teaching; else 3yrs (three 1-yr contracts) + optional 4th. Accurate.
Handbook references 'minimum state salary schedule'/'extra-duty pay schedule' only; no actual schedule table or year coverage. not_discussed valid, not a false neg.
Verbatim at p24: 9.05(c) 'Applicants must comply with District certification requirements...' + (f) ESOL endorsement/K-12 cert; also 1.02 CERTIFICATION. Cert/endorsement clearly present.
Article 12.02 ACADEMIC: 'teachers shall have academic freedom within the outlines of course content and the curriculum' verbatim, p48. Evidence genuine.
Article 12.01 PERSONAL protects teacher's citizenship right to political preference off-premises; quote verbatim at p48. Correct.
ESOL Contact Person stipend ($600-$1,000 by student count) verbatim in supp. schedule p68; ESOL is high-need. Also 15.06 Critical Shortage/Alt School bonuses, 15.08 reading incentive.
Coded not_discussed, but 15.06 names 'Advanced Placement Test' bonus (performance/outcome-based legislative bonus). Thin reference, no merit scheme, but topic surfaces; mild false negative.

Evidence quote appears in TOC, but A-2 'Professional Advancement Schedule' is actually degree-lane pay supplements (BA+30/MA/MA+30/Doc) + NBC stipend, not a career ladder or differentiated roles. Overstated.
Verbatim at 8-2.2 (line 845): 30-min lunch free of supervisory/admin duties. Answer right; page cite '1' is off (actually Article 8) but evidence supports.
Sec 5-3 (lines 466-472) matches 5/3/1 tiers verbatim (immediate/in-laws/extended relatives). Page cite correct.
Clean extraction (3761 lines); opening AGREEMENT quote verbatim at lines 3-6. Usable confirmed.

Not a false negative. No general prior-teaching-experience salary-placement clause; only narrow athletic-director coaching credit (line 3137) + leave->increment service credit (5-5). not_discussed correct.
Verbatim at DNA(LEGAL) CLASSROOM OBSERVATION: 'minimum of 45 min-utes'. Answer 45 correct.
Full quote confirmed at DBF NONSCHOOL EMPLOYMENT (LOCAL); primary employment + no private tutoring of own students. yes correct.
Quote confirmed at DK ASSIGNMENT AND SCHEDULES (LOCAL): emergency/schools must close, Superintendent may modify provisions.
Confirmed in WORK LOAD DL(LEGAL) planning/prep: 'a teacher may not be required to participate in any other activity.' Restricts planning time.
not_discussed correct, not a false neg: policy-only doc (DEA) references minimum salary schedule framework; no actual schedule grid or coverage year present.
Appendix A real salary grid (Steps 1-16 x BA/BA+16/MA/MA+16/MA+32/Non-degree), ~p.171; evidence quote appears verbatim.
Verbatim at lines 4084-85 (p.84): 10 min individual preparation + 10 min common planning time guaranteed.
Quoted sentence genuine (p.10) & cites federal regs, but 'quote all' incomplete: misses FMLA (l.7665), COBRA, 'federal/state constitutions, statutes' (l.6700), IRS/social security (l.3457).
Dental clearly available; 93.9%/97.4% indemnity (l.2454-55) and 95% prepaid (l.2493-94) quotes match, p.45.
True negative: 'incentive pay/days' are attendance-based (low sick-leave usage), not merit/performance/evaluation comp; step-and-lane schedule only.
Verbatim at line 7023: 'At least one classroom observation of a minimum of 45 minutes.' Answer 45 correct.
Verbatim lines 1495-96: discharged for good cause per Sec 21.156 Educ Code. Good-cause dismissal pervasive. Answer yes correct.
Verbatim lines 6466-69: duty-free-lunch exception requiring teacher to supervise students during lunch. Non-teaching duty present. Yes correct.
Verbatim line 186: 'electronic representation of TASB's record of the district's currently adopted policy manual.' Policy manual correct.
FALSE NEGATIVE: coded not_discussed but Appendix A-1..A-5 (lines 16273-16439) are explicit 'Teacher Salary Schedule - 2005-2006' step grids. Year=2005-2006.
All 3 evidence quotes verbatim in GADM (lines 13356/13443/13359): commence at close of school year, full year + 1yr extension, written request by June 1, 1% cap. Accurate.
Evidence real (GADA lines 12661-65) but it is a policy that board 'shall adopt a schedule', not an actual schedule. No grid/steps/amounts/years anywhere. 'yes' overstates.
'minimum of 180 teaching days' (line 533) and two-60%-days-with-staff-development clause (line 566) verified verbatim. Answer accurate.
'30 self contained / 33 departmentalized grades 5-8' verified (line 859-860); correctly flagged extended-year-only. General class-size policy just cites state statute; no HS number. Accurate.
No actual salary schedule with year coverage exists in doc (only policy reference). 'not_discussed' correct; NOT a false negative.
Immediate-family def (lines 4534-4545) lists all coded relatives + household member; governs bereavement/'death in immediate family' leave (line 4619). Quote verbatim.
Drug testing + alcohol-use rules verbatim at lines 214-224; drug-free workplace policy 8789-8810; alcohol/drug testing 9217+. 'yes' correct.
Exact match lines 4011-4012: pregnancy considered temporary disability; also 158-161, 4002-4006. 'yes' correct.
Sec VII lines 29814-29825: out-of-state exp credited full value if fully accredited by state agency. Evidence mislabels clause 'C' (source 'B') but substance verbatim.
not_discussed correct; only conceptual 'general salary increase authorized by Board' (29655-56), no across-the-board raise amount or COLA percentage specified. Not a false negative.

items.note: Verbatim on pg 3 (NEW APPENDIX - SLP). Passive 'shall be compensated', management acts, worker benefits, right. All features correct.
Verbatim pg 2 Sec 13 B2 (truncated mid-quote); full clause '...shall be paid an hourly rate' = passive. management/worker/right all correct.
Verbatim pg 7 (items 1 & 4). Active 'shall make', acting_party 'other' (joint body), obligation correct. protected_party=worker is a mild stretch (procedural) but defensible.
Verbatim pg 1 Sec 1. Passive 'shall be increased', management acts, worker benefits, obligation. All features correct.
Verbatim (p region L1229). 'must be approved'=passive correct; acting/protected=management correct. statement_type 'right' defensible as mgmt approval authority.
Verbatim (L848-53). Voice active & acting_party mgmt correct, but protected_party 'worker' wrong: beneficiaries are parents/public, not workers.
Verbatim (L400-01). 'are allowed to be renewed'=passive correct; permission correct; acting/protected=mgmt correct.
Verbatim (L1118-22). 'will be separated'=passive correct; job_security topic correct; obligation correct.
Verbatim (L367-68). 'will be issued'=passive correct; protected_party=worker correct (employees receive card).
Verbatim across line break (p29). Voice passive ('are indicated') correct. Informational/'other' statement; protected_party=management arbitrary but harmless given other/other coding.
Verbatim ('...then the employee may be terminated.'); pipeline's own quote_verified=False is mistaken. Voice passive, modal may, permission, acting/protected=management all correct.
Quote NOT verbatim: source reads 'who teach part of a day ARE INSTRUCTIONAL PERSONNEL AND cannot take annual leave...'; middle phrase spliced out. Fabrication.
Verbatim (skilled-trades apprentice section). Voice passive ('will be promoted'), protected_party=worker (beneficiary), acting=management, modal will all correct.
Verbatim in §8.5.3.1.c (printed pg 8). 'shall be contacted'=passive OK; HR Office=mgmt actor; surplus personnel=worker beneficiary. All features correct.
Core clause verbatim §17.12.1 but bracketed tail '[speech improvement schools]' fabricated; actual text: 'each school site, except opportunity schools'. Coded features OK.
Verbatim §12.2.1.1 (printed pg 2). 'is added'=passive OK; worker (doctorate teacher)=beneficiary; empty modal correct. All features correct.
Verbatim §8.4.9 'Surplussing of Counselors'. 'shall be used'=passive OK. protected_party=management is off; these surplussing procedures benefit counselors (worker).
Verbatim §8.5.4.1. voice=passive wrong: 'shall be those with the greatest seniority' is a predicate-nominative/equative construction, not passive (no verb+ed). worker beneficiary OK.
Verbatim (p~44, lines 2022-2025). Passive 'must be filed by Teacher Rights Committee' correct; acting=worker (TRC files), protected=worker (grievance right), obligation. All features right.
Verbatim (lines 1537-38). 'may be required' passive correct; mgmt requires & benefits (verifies illness), teacher obligated to provide proof. Features right.

Verbatim (line 1377). Active/negation/other-actor(signature)/worker-benefit all correct, but statement_type 'prohibition' is off: declarative that signature != agreement, not a prohibition (llm_judgment 'other' fits).
Verbatim (line 986). 'The Board shall give' active correct; acting=management, protected=worker (teacher receives decision), obligation. All features right.
Verbatim (line 1623). 'will be discarded' passive correct; actor unspecified=other, use-it-or-lose-it benefits management (limits bank), obligation/other. Features right.
Quote verbatim (p13). Voice 'passive' correct ('is required...to notify'). protected_party=worker wrong: beneficiary is parents/guardians (=other), not worker.
Quote verbatim. active/will/obligation correct. protected_party=worker wrong: District notifies parents/guardians of a student (=other), not worker.
Quote verbatim (bullet under 'Reemployment is not required if'). Condition benefiting District; acting=other, protected=management, other/other all reasonable.
Quote verbatim (Policy GKC). Passive ('are expected'), obligation on visitors (other actor), benefits District (management). All features correct.
Quote verbatim (Std 3.8, TX Ethics). worker/active/shall/obligation correct. protected_party=management off: educator-student boundary benefits students (=other).
Verbatim (line 1822). 'must be reported'=passive correct; obligation correct. acting_party=worker & protected=management both defensible for accident-reporting duty.
Verbatim (line 1160). Voice WRONG: 'shall be clean, neat, appropriate' is predicative adjective, not passive. (acting_party arguably worker, who must comply.)
Verbatim (line 2035). 'must be restored'=passive correct; mgmt acts, worker benefits. statement_type=right vs llm=obligation both defensible (employer duty=worker protection).
Quote NOT verbatim: source (line 3476) says 'check on the STUDENT'; pipeline wrote 'check on the child'. Voice/prohibition/negation features fine but quote altered.
Verbatim (line 817). Active main clause 'employee receives' correct; framed as entitlement=right; worker acting & protected correct.
Verbatim (p.~soiled linen/Laundry Procedures). 'are determined by' = passive, correct. Descriptive statement; statement_type/llm 'other' fit. protected_party ambiguous but non-rights clause.

Verbatim (Automatic Payroll Deposit). Voice passive + obligation correct, but acting_party='management' wrong: employees(worker) are the ones required to authorize (cf. identical chunk101 coded worker).

Verbatim (hand sanitizer safety). Passive/modal 'should'/negation True correct, but statement_type='permission' wrong: 'should never be placed' is a prohibition (llm_judgment correctly says prohibition).
Verbatim (Dissemination of Required Information). 'You may also find' = active/permission/may, acting+protected=worker all correct.
Verbatim (Bullying, Policy FFI). 'are required to report' = passive, acting_party worker, obligation correct. protected_party 'management' defensible (reports go to principal/District oversight).

Verbatim (p13/line713-14). Passive 'shall be provided' correct; acting=worker (teacher provides), protected=management, llm=obligation all right. statement_type 'right' loose but llm captures obligation.
Verbatim (line1659-60). Passive 'shall be granted' correct; acting=management (grants), protected=management, negation True, llm=prohibition all right. statement_type 'other' acceptable catch-all.
Verbatim (line589-90). Voice passive, acting=mgmt, protected=worker, negation, llm=prohibition all correct. But statement_type 'permission' contradicts this prohibition (opposite polarity).
Verbatim (line974-75). Active 'may bring' correct; acting=worker, protected=worker (teacher benefits), modal may, permission all right.
Verbatim (line1805-06). Active 'must request' correct; acting=worker, protected=management (Board benefits from notice), modal must, obligation all right.
Verbatim (line 2613, §14-2). Passive 'shall be given' correct; protected=worker (teachers receive notice); management gives it. right/obligation views coherent.
Verbatim (§16-3.6, line 2769). Active correct; negation True; protected=worker (union benefits from admin not aiding rivals). permission+negation=prohibition coherent.
Verbatim (lines 2839-44), truncated at 'on le' but not fabricated. Active 'School Board agrees to contribute' correct; protected=worker; topic benefits correct.
Verbatim (line 832). Active 'shall perform' correct; worker acts, management (Board) benefits from class-size monitoring; obligation/workload correct.
Verbatim (lines 3078-82). Voice passive & protected=worker correct, but acting_party should be management (employer compensates), not worker — hidden agent of passive 'shall be compensated'.
Verbatim (line 8432). Passive 'is not required', negation True, modal empty all correct. Management benefits from notice waiver; acting=management coherent. Right.
Verbatim (line 8431). Passive 'may be given', modal may, worker benefits from receiving notice. Correct mirror of chunk 205.
Verbatim (line 578). Active 'may include', modal may, descriptive eval-standard clause coded other/permission. Features fine.
Verbatim (line 4213). Active 'shall include'=obligation, modal shall. acting=other (the notice/Board) defensible. Correct.
Verbatim (line 682). Passive 'shall be made'=obligation, modal shall. Employer due-diligence check; features correct.
Quote verbatim (p.24/L4207). Passive & protected_party=management OK, but acting_party should be management (the principal makes assignments), not worker.
Quote verbatim (L1945-47). Board=management acting, employees=worker benefit, active voice, will/obligation all correct.
Quote verbatim (L5153-54). 'shall be made known'=passive OK; protected_party=worker(teacher) OK. right vs obligation are defensible dual views of same clause.
Quote verbatim (L6745-47). No-strike clause: acting_party=worker, protected_party=management, active voice all correct; obligation/prohibition dual view OK.
Quote verbatim (L2186-88). 'Board shall pay'=active, management acts, worker benefits, obligation all correct.

Verbatim (line 4908, dispute-resolution sect). Passive + permission correct; protected_party=management (benefits from power to reject grievance) OK; acting_party 'other' defensible for unstated passive actor.

Verbatim (line 5701). Active + acting=management OK, but protected_party should be worker/students (harassment protection benefits victims, not management); also a prohibition, not statement_type 'other'.
Verbatim (line 6875). Passive, acting=management, protected=worker all correct. statement_type 'right' slightly generous vs 'permission' since text adds notice 'is not required'.
Verbatim (line 4036). Active voice, acting=management (Board), protected=worker, obligation all correct.
Verbatim across line break (lines 6095-97). Obligation, acting=management, protected=worker correct. Voice 'passive' borderline (copular 'shall be available') but reads as elided passive.
Verbatim at L6269-70 (incl. odd ',.'). Passive 'shall be placed' correct, obligation. Vendor->worker, JPSD->management defensible in binary scheme. Procurement clause.
Verbatim at L9945-46. Voice passive/actor(mgmt)/type correct, but protected_party=worker mislabels beneficiary=pupils/students. Tornado-drill clause, not labor.
Verbatim at L1767-68. Passive/actor(mgmt) ok, but beneficiary is public records requester, not 'worker'. statement_type=right vs llm=obligation (both defensible).
Verbatim at L8150-51 (incl. grammatical 'a local school events'). Passive 'shall be used', obligation; both parties=management (financial control benefits district).
Verbatim at L6119-20. Voice=passive WRONG: 'shall not be responsible' is copular/adjective, not 'be <verb>ed'; should be active. Liability disclaimer, parties ok.
Verbatim (lines 6322-23). Passive 'may not be appealed', mgmt benefits, prohibition, modal may+neg all correct. acting_party 'other' ok (unstated agent in passive).
Quote NOT verbatim: silently omits 'and require testing for illegal drugs, alcohol, and/or controlled substances' after 'duty'. Stitched/elided. Features (mgmt permission, active) otherwise correct.
Verbatim (line 8930). statement_type 'permission' misreads epistemic 'may result in' (a disciplinary consequence) as deontic permission; llm_judgment 'other' apter. Voice active ok.
Verbatim (lines 4352-54). Worker acts/benefits, right, no modal, 'be entitled'=passive ok, negation False (entitlement affirmative). All correct.
Verbatim (lines 3649-51). Passive 'shall be determined by the Superintendent', mgmt actor/beneficiary, shall obligation all correct.
